verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt (it returns 404), but Buzz does ship agent-oriented docs. A root AGENTS.md is live (HTTP 200), and the repo mirrors skills into .agents, .claude, .codex and .goose so those harnesses find them natively. A packaged buzz-cli skill also covers relay operations for the managed agent. However, AGENTS.md is aimed at agents contributing to the codebase, not at agents learning to use the product. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt or llms-full.txt, product-usage docs aimed at agents beyond the bundled CLI skill, and independent hands-on corroboration that agents consume these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: This guide is for AI agents contributing to the Buzz codebase.
the repo mirrors vendor-shipped skills into .agents/, .claude/, .codex/, and .goose/skills/ so four agent harnesses discover them natively
relay operations: owner-reviewed agent drafts, messaging, channels, DMs, users, workflows, feed, reactions, canvas, social, repos, uploads, and agent memory.
